troid's research · tearsheet

A full tearsheet on a strategy whose holdout expectancy is +0.008R. Every metric below is MEASURED and inside noise. Published because that is what noise looks like when someone shows you all of it.

95 closed trades on BINANCE:BTCUSDT 4h, 2026-02-07 to 2026-10-29. Daily P&L on the $100,000 quota, days without an exit count as zero, 365 periods a year, sums not products. Source: journal.csv in the repo. Not financial advice.
